## Details

<a id="panel_font"></a>
### [`panel_font`](../../../../src/graphics/panel_charset.asm#L6) `$E100-$E107`

*data*

Characters $20-$5f of the panel (text rows 0-4, colour RAM 6): space, yin-yang, punctuation, digits and upper case letters in ASCII order.
Char $20: space.

<a id="panel_yinyang_chars"></a>
### [`panel_yinyang_chars`](../../../../src/graphics/panel_charset.asm#L9) `$E108-$E147`

*data*

Chars $21-$24: full yin-yang symbol (2x2, draw_yin_yang_full $1dde). Chars $25-$28: half yin-yang symbol ($1df3). v1 had them at $01-$08; v2 puts them in place of the characters ! " # $ % & ' (.

<a id="panel_font_rest"></a>
### [`panel_font_rest`](../../../../src/graphics/panel_charset.asm#L19) `$E148-$E2FF`

*data*

Chars $29-$5f: the same bytes as the v1 font. The texts use space, '.', digits and upper case letters only.
